content.name: Megan O'Sullivan
content.title: Practice Team Leader and Senior Practice Assistant
content.summary: Practice assistant and reception leader with 15 years in Perth general practice, holding a Certificate IV in Medical Practice Assisting. I lead 11 reception and practice assistant staff at a 14-GP clinic and steered us through two RACGP Standards accreditations with no critical findings.

experience.title: Medical Receptionist
bullets: Greeted and booked 150+ patients a day for 8 GPs, processing Medicare bulk billing and private fees in Best Practice.
Managed the recall and reminder list for cervical screening and immunisations, contacting around 90 patients a week.
Covered after-hours on-call phone triage scripts and escalated urgent calls to the duty doctor.

experience.title: Senior Medical Receptionist
bullets: Supervised a reception roster of 6 staff and trained new starters on Medicare item numbers and privacy procedures.
Introduced HotDoc online bookings, which handled 45% of appointments within a year and freed up phone lines.
Cut the overdue account balance from $27,000 to $8,500 by setting up regular statements and payment plans.

experience.title: Practice Assistant
bullets: Performed ECGs, spirometry, wound dressing set-up and vital signs for 14 GPs under delegation from the practice nurses.
Managed vaccine cold chain for a fridge holding $60,000 of stock, following the National Vaccine Storage Guidelines with twice-daily data-logger checks.
Prepared health assessment templates for 75+ and chronic disease management plans, lifting completed plans by 26%.
Set up the drive-through COVID-19 testing flow that saw 2,400 patients in its first eight weeks.

experience.title: Practice Team Leader
bullets: Lead 11 receptionists and practice assistants, owning rosters, performance reviews and training plans.
Coordinated evidence for two accreditation cycles against the RACGP Standards for general practices, with no critical findings at either visit.
Rebuilt the triage scripts with the GP partners, cutting same-day appointment overflow to the nurse team by 30%.
Introduced a quarterly induction day and skills checklist, reducing new-starter errors in Medicare claiming by 60%.

achievements.detail: Named staff member of the year by the clinic's GP partners.

achievements.detail: Two consecutive RACGP Standards accreditations with no critical findings.
